source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.4 with Quick Checks 22.3 and 22.4 answered, printed pages 89-92 (PDF 92-95).

blocks.text: i. Alcohols ka jalna (combustion)
Alcohols ko aag lagayi jaye to woh poori tarah jal kar (complete combustion) carbon dioxide aur paani bana dete hain.
Yeh reaction bohat exothermic (bohat garmi chhorne wala) hai; isi liye kuch mulkon mein alcohol petrol ki jagah istemal hota hai.
ii. Substitution reaction

Alcohols ke substitution (badal dena) mein hydroxy group (-OH) ki jagah koi aur group (jaise halogen) aa jata hai aur naya product (jaise halogenoalkane) banta hai. -OH ki jagah halogen aane ka reaction neeche diya gaya hai; ZnCl₂ catalyst hai.
Quick Check 22.3

blocks.prompt: Propan-1-ol ka SOCl₂ se reaction likhein.
PCl₃ aur PCl₅ ke propan-1-ol se reactions ka farq chemical equations se dikhayein.
blocks.explanation: PCl₃: 3CH₃CH₂CH₂OH + PCl₃ → 3CH₃CH₂CH₂Cl + H₃PO₃. PCl₅: CH₃CH₂CH₂OH + PCl₅ → CH₃CH₂CH₂Cl + POCl₃ + HCl. PCl₃ teen alcohol molecules se react kar ke H₃PO₃ deta hai; PCl₅ ek molecule se react kar ke POCl₃ aur HCl gas deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethanol KBr se kaise react karta hai? Equation dein.
blocks.explanation: Concentrated sulphuric acid ke saath; acid aur KBr mil kar HBr banate hain jo ethanol ke -OH ki jagah Br laga deta hai: CH₃CH₂OH + KBr + H₂SO₄ → CH₃CH₂Br + KHSO₄ + H₂O

blocks.text: iii. Sodium metal se reaction

Jab alcohol sodium (Na) jaisi reactive metal se react karta hai to hydroxyl group ka oxygen-hydrogen bond toot jata hai. Yeh reaction sodium aur paani ke reaction se kam tez hai, phir bhi hydrogen gas nikalti hai aur ek base (alkoxide) banta hai. Is reaction ko hydroxy (-OH) group ke test ke liye istemal kar sakte hain: agar -OH group maujood ho to hydrogen gas ke bulbule nikalte hain. Reaction ke baad bacha hua (excess) ethanol uda dein to sodium alkoxide ka safaid crystalline solid bachta hai. Alcohol ki hydrocarbon zanjeer jitni lambi ho, reaction utna hi kam tez hota hai.

Phenolphthalein aur ethanol ke solution mein sodium dalne par pink rang dheere dheere aata hai. Paani mein pink rang foran aa jata hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke Na ka ethanol se reaction paani ke muqable mein aahista hai.
iv. Alcohols ki oxidation

Oxidizing agents se primary alcohols oxidise ho kar aldehydes bante hain aur secondary alcohols sirf ketones. Tertiary alcohols oxidise nahi hote. Alcohols ke oxidising agents mein acidified (tezab mila) K₂Cr₂O₇ aur acidified KMnO₄ shamil hain. Acidified potassium dichromate(VI), K₂Cr₂O₇, orange rang ka oxidising agent hai. Alcohol oxidise hone par orange dichromate ions (Cr₂O₇²⁻) reduce ho kar green Cr³⁺ ions ban jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne K₂Cr₂O₇ ko 'potassium chromate(VI)' likha hai; sahi naam potassium dichromate(VI) hai. Potassium chromate(VI) ka formula K₂CrO₄ hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ethanol ke neeche 'ethonal' chhapa hai; sahi naam ethanol hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein (Keep in Mind)
blocks.text: Potassium dichromate(VI) jab oxidising agent ka kaam karta hai to woh khud reduce hota hai. Is reduction ke liye hydrogen (H⁺) ions chahiye, jo acidic medium (tezab) deta hai.

Is liye sirf primary aur secondary alcohols ki oxidation acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ solution ka rang badalti hai, kyunke orange Cr₂O₇²⁻ ions reduce ho kar green Cr³⁺ ions ban jate hain. Isi se primary ya secondary alcohol ki maujoodgi check ki jati hai.

blocks.alt: Tezaabi potassium dichromate ki teen test tubes: propan-1-ol (primary alcohol) gehra hara, propan-2-ol (secondary alcohol) gehra hara, aur 2-methyl-propan-2-ol (tertiary alcohol) narangi.
blocks.caption: Primary, secondary aur tertiary alcohols ke saath tezaabi potassium dichromate (kitab ke PDF safha 94 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Primary (propan-1-ol) aur secondary (propan-2-ol) alcohols oxidise hote hain, is liye orange Cr₂O₇²⁻ ions green Cr³⁺ ions ban jate hain. Tertiary alcohol (2-methyl-propan-2-ol) ke -OH wale carbon par H nahi, woh oxidise nahi hota, is liye solution orange hi rehta hai.
Sirf propan-1-ol (primary) aur propan-2-ol (secondary) oxidise hote hain aur orange solution ko green kar dete hain; 2-methyl-propan-2-ol (tertiary) ke saath rang nahi badalta.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat (Interesting Information)
blocks.text: Sharab pee kar gaari chalana bohat khatarnak hai. Breathalyser ek aala (device) hai jis se traffic officers check karte hain ke driver nashe mein hai ya nahi. Yeh device driver ki saans ke ethanol ko oxidise karta hai. Oxidation mein electrons nikalte hain, aur in se banne wala current alcohol ki miqdar ke barabar hisaab (proportional) se hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke ethanol ki oxidation ko electrons 'chahiye' (requires electrons). Asal mein oxidation mein electrons nikalte hain; yahi electrons current banate hain jo naapa jata hai.
Quick Check 22.4

blocks.alt: Teen skeletal C4H10O alcohols: i) teen carbon ki zanjeer ke sire par OH aur darmiyani carbon par methyl; ii) aik carbon jis par teen methyl aur OH; iii) chaar carbon ki zanjeer ke doosre carbon par OH.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 22.4: alcohols A, B aur C (banawatein i-iii) (kitab ke PDF safha 94 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Teen alcohols A, B aur C, C₄H₁₀O ke structural isomers hain. Har ek ko acidified dichromate(VI), H⁺/Cr₂O₇²⁻, ke saath reflux kiya jata hai. i) Alcohol C ka systematic naam likhein. ii) Alcohol A ke complete combustion ki equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: i) C (structure iii) butan-2-ol hai. ii) A (structure i) 2-methylpropan-1-ol hai: C₄H₉OH + 6O₂ → 4CO₂ + 5H₂O

blocks.prompt: Acidified KMnO₄ purple oxidising agent hai. Manganate ions (MnO₄⁻) se alcohols oxidise hon to rang mein kya tabdeeli dikhegi?
blocks.explanation: Purple se be-rang (colourless), kyunke purple MnO₄⁻ ions reduce ho kar taqreeban be-rang Mn²⁺ ions ban jate hain.

blocks.prompt: A, B aur C ki oxidation ke organic products ki structures banayein (reaction na ho to 'NONE' likhein).
blocks.explanation: A (primary, 2-methylpropan-1-ol): reflux par 2-methylpropanoic acid, (CH₃)₂CHCOOH (pehle 2-methylpropanal banta hai). B (tertiary, 2-methylpropan-2-ol): NONE. C (secondary, butan-2-ol): butanone, CH₃COCH₂CH₃.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Quick Check mein manganate ion 'MnO⁴⁻' chhapa hai; sahi formula MnO₄⁻ hai.
v. Alcohols ki dehydration
Alcohols dehydration se alkenes bhi bana sakte hain. Dehydration elimination reaction ki ek qism hai jis mein paani ka ek molecule nikal diya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala ETHANOL, teer ke oopar Al2O3 aur neeche Heat (garmi), se khuli banawat wali ETHENE, H2C=CH2, + H2O.
blocks.caption: Ethanol ki dehydration se ethene (kitab ke PDF safha 94 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Dehydrating agents (paani nikalne wale) aluminium oxide, concentrated sulphuric acid, concentrated phosphoric acid waghera ho sakte hain.
Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Alcohols jal kar CO₂ aur H₂O dete hain; ethanol ka ΔH°c = −1367 kJ mol⁻¹.
Substitution: -OH ki jagah halogen (HCl/ZnCl₂, SOCl₂, PCl₃, PCl₅, KBr + H₂SO₄).
Na se alkoxide + H₂ (-OH group ka test).
Oxidation (acidified K₂Cr₂O₇, orange se green): primary se aldehyde, secondary se ketone, tertiary nahi.
Dehydration (Al₂O₃ garmi, ya concentrated acid) se alkene.
